course.name: MBChB Medicine
course.notes: UK-only standard-entry A100. Graduates apply through A100; there is no separate A101 graduate-entry programme. Lincoln A106 Gateway is a separate route and pool.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Year 13 / GCSE-recent applicants are ranked by GCSE points, UCAT cognitive band points, SJT points and capped contextual uplift.
Post-A Level, undergraduate and graduate applicants are ranked on doubled UCAT cognitive plus SJT points only.

overall_policy.description: Lincoln A100 checks academic eligibility, requires current-cycle UCAT, rejects SJT Band 4, then routes applicants to Model A or Model B for pre-interview ranking.
not_eligible_if: International/overseas-fee applicants apply to an unsupported route: Lincoln A100 is UK-only in the supplied evidence.
The supported academic route minimums are not met.
UCAT was not sat in the current admissions cycle.

gcse.scoring_summary: Best six GCSEs must include Biology, Chemistry or Double Science, Mathematics and English Language, plus two highest others. Grades 9,8,7,6,5,4 score 5,4,3,2,1,0 respectively; maximum 30.
gcse.resits: Permitted if awarded by the time of application.

contextual_offer.notes: Contextual offer reduction is offer-stage metadata and does not alter pre-interview threshold bands.

a_level.excluded_subjects_text: General Studies, Critical Thinking, EPQ, Global Perspectives and Citizenship Studies are not accepted for the offer requirement.

international_baccalaureate.notes: IB applicants also need supporting GCSE/IB Middle Years science, English and Maths evidence. Route-specific scoring is not separately calibrated beyond the GCSE-recent versus post-qualification rule.

scottish.national_5: At least 6 Grade As or GCSE equivalent including Biology and Chemistry; Maths and English Language at Grade B minimum.
scottish.highers: AAABB including Biology, Chemistry, Maths and English Language, with A in Biology.
scottish.notes: The generic evaluator can record Scottish requirements but Lincoln-specific National 5 scoring equivalence requires manual review if GCSE-equivalent grades are not supplied in gcse_profile.

graduate.accepted_route: A100 only; no separate A101 graduate entry programme.
graduate.relevant_degree_route: 2:1 in a relevant UK Honours degree plus GCSE Maths and English Language Grade 5; Chemistry/Double Science unless covered at A Level or in transcript.
graduate.any_degree_route: 2:1 in any Honours degree plus standard A Level and GCSE requirements.
graduate.degree_conferred_deadline: Early August of entry year; final-year students may hold conditional offers.

post_16.notes: A Levels are not scored. Completed A Levels, current/completed undergraduate study and graduate status switch applicants to Model B.

ucat.notes: Lincoln publishes no fixed UCAT cut-off. Cognitive total is converted to official band points.

resits.conditions: GCSE resits must be awarded by application. A Level resits must normally achieve AAA, or AAB contextual with A in Biology, usually within two years of first sitting.

english_language.notes: International route is not applicable to Lincoln A100 in the supplied evidence.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Professional checks are offer-holder requirements and are not used for interview prediction.

non_academic.work_experience: No specific clinical work-experience requirement; expected insight into NHS/caring work for interview reflection.
non_academic.personal_statement: Checked after interview, not scored pre-interview.

model_routing.model_a: GCSE-recent / Year 13 applicants: GCSE 30 + UCAT cognitive 15 + SJT 15 + contextual up to 12, capped at 60.
model_routing.model_b: Post-A Level, undergraduate and graduate applicants: (UCAT cognitive 15 + SJT 15) doubled, capped at 60.

selection_adjustments.notes: Model A contextual measures are summed and capped at 12 points. Contextual points are not applied to Model B degree-holder applicants.
SJT Band 4 is an automatic rejection at application.

score_components.notes: Model A only. Highest six GCSEs must include Biology, Chemistry or Double Science, Maths and English Language; 9=5, 8=4, 7=3, 6=2, 5=1, 4=0.
UCAT cognitive contributes up to 15 points in Model A and is doubled to 30 in Model B.
Band 1=15, Band 2=10, Band 3=5; Band 4 rejects. SJT points are doubled in Model B.
Model A only; care leaver/refugee 12, MEM2 Q1 10, MEM2 Q2 8, UCAT bursary 6, LMS WP summer school 6, Lincolnshire residence 2; total capped at 12.

total_score.notes: Both official pathways are capped at 60. The applicant qualification stage is the routing key.

calculation.notes: A Levels are not scored. The official score calculation is separate from ApplySmart's low-confidence provisional strategic bands.

quotas_or_pools.notes: A100 and A106 ranked as separate pools. No international A100 places in the supplied evidence.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: The 45-50/60 competitive zone is used only as a low-confidence provisional strategic benchmark. It is not an official Lincoln cutoff, and modelled interview numbers remain display-only context.

adjustments.notes: Multiple criteria are summed and capped at 12. Degree holders / Model B applicants do not receive the contextual score uplift.
Offer-condition metadata only; not used for ApplySmart offer prediction.

contextual_admissions.notes: Lincoln contextual criteria alter Model A pre-interview scoring through an official capped matrix and may reduce offer conditions. They are not a separate pool and do not apply to degree holders.

ranking_pools.name: A100 Home / UK pool
ranking_pools.notes: Single UK/Home pool; no international A100 pool.

ranking_pools.name: A106 Gateway pool
ranking_pools.notes: Separate A106 route, not part of this A100 profile.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
Official A100 home places for the 2026 entry cycle in the supplied research.
Lincoln A100 is UK-only in the supplied evidence; international applicants cannot apply.

offer_selection.formula_recorded_for_transparency_only: MMI /70 + halved Combined Academic Score /30 = final /100.
offer_selection.notes: ApplySmart does not predict offers; offer-stage academic carry-forward is stored for decision transparency only.

cycles.notes: No official threshold is published for Lincoln's first independent A100 cycle.
No official independent-cycle interview number is published.

interview_threshold.evidence_gap: Lincoln publishes no current fixed interview threshold; threshold varies yearly.

interview_numbers.evidence_gap: First independent-cycle interview numbers are not yet published.

historical_reference_only.note: Partnership-era UCAT data on old 3600 scale; not comparable to current scoring.
Partnership-era effective cut-off under old system; not used in runtime logic.

provisional_prediction_bands.reason: No official calibration exists before first-cycle data; ApplySmart labels these bands as provisional strategic guidance.

historical_admissions.notes: Historical Nottingham partnership-era data and modelled interview numbers are retained only as reference/display metadata. The estimated Lincoln competitive zone may support provisional strategic guidance, but never an official threshold claim.

home.notes: Home-fee applicants are the only supported A100 fee pool in the supplied evidence.

international.notes: Lincoln A100 has 0 international places in the supplied evidence.

validation.confidence_level: High for official scoring rules; low for interview prediction calibration
known_unknowns: No official Lincoln A100 interview threshold is published for the first independent cycle.
No official independent-cycle interview numbers are published.
Graduate relevant-degree subject/transcript coverage cannot be inferred from free text.
Scottish National 5 scoring equivalence requires manual review unless supplied as GCSE-equivalent structured grades.
Science practical endorsement requirement is not explicitly published.
validation.review_notes: Runtime scoring uses only official rules. Estimated thresholds, modelled interview numbers and provisional bands are preserved as non-runtime metadata.

engine_assumptions: Predicted A Level applicants are treated as GCSE-recent / Model A where qualification_status is predicted.
Achieved A Level, undergraduate and graduate applicants are routed to Model B by structured qualification route/status fields.
Lincoln contextual criteria are supplied as structured applicant_group_ids so the official capped matrix can be evaluated without inferring from free text.
evidence_gaps: No official interview threshold is published for the first independent Lincoln cycle.
No official A100 interview-number data is published for the independent cycle.
Scottish National 5 scoring equivalence requires manual review unless GCSE-equivalent grades are supplied in the standard GCSE profile.
Graduate relevant-degree subject/transcript coverage cannot be inferred from free text and may require manual review.
Science practical endorsement requirement is not explicitly published.
do_not_infer: Do not use the estimated 45-50/60 competitive zone as an official runtime threshold; it may only support clearly labelled provisional strategic guidance.
Do not use historical Nottingham partnership UCAT figures as current Lincoln cut-offs.
Do not apply contextual points to Model B degree-holder applicants.
